questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: [MULTI-CORRECT: +4 / -2 with Partial Marking] A uniform thin rod of mass $M$ and length $L$ rests on a smooth horizontal tabletop. A horizontal impulse $J$ is applied perpendicular to the rod at a distance $x = \frac{L}{6}$ from its center $O$. Which of the following statements is/are correct immediately after the impulse?
options: The center of mass velocity is $v_{\text{cm}} = \frac{J}{M}$
The angular velocity about the center of mass is $\omega = \frac{2J}{ML}$
The instantaneous axis of rotation lies at distance $\frac{L}{2}$ from center $O$ on the opposite side
The kinetic energy imparted to the rod is $\frac{2J^2}{3M}$
